tools.name: sync_project_assets
tools.title: Sync Project
tools.description: Create or fully replace a project: its manifest (relations included) and its internal docs. For a partial change use update_project.

id.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

targetId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

localPath.description: Physical disk path of the project

billing.description: Billing: plain = the plan or terms in free text, price = the price as text

tools.name: upload_project_asset
tools.title: Upload Project Asset
tools.description: Upload a binary file (base64) to a project's asset folder.

projectId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

fileName.description: Filename only; unsafe characters are replaced

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update Project
tools.description: Patch project manifest fields (partial update).

projectId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

targetId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

localPath.description: Physical disk path of the project

billing.description: Billing: plain = the plan or terms in free text, price = the price as text

patch.description: Manifest fields to update. 'id' cannot be changed here; use rename_project.

tools.name: rename_project
tools.title: Rename Project
tools.description: Rename project ID with cascading relation updates.

oldId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

newId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

tools.name: search_projects
tools.title: Search Projects
tools.description: Search projects by id, name or description.

tools.name: get_global_topology
tools.title: Project Topology
tools.description: Without projectId: every project (id, name, summary, last active) with project and relation totals. With projectId: that project and the projects it depends on, directly or through others (outgoing relations only); an unknown projectId is an error.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Read Project
tools.description: Read a project's full manifest and, by default, its internal docs.

projectId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'

billing.description: Billing: plain = the plan or terms in free text, price = the price as text

tools.name: peers
tools.title: List Peers
tools.description: List the AI sessions (Claude Code / Codex conversations) you can message, and your own profile; offline ones only with includeOffline. status: listening (waiting for messages, answers right away), working or idle (sees a message when its user next sends a prompt or it next calls a tool), or offline (ended, or no activity for 30 minutes).

includeOffline.description: Also list offline sessions active in the last 24 hours

tools.name: send
tools.title: Send Direct Message
tools.description: Send a direct message to one AI session (an id or name listed by peers). The recipient is notified automatically and reads it with read; to answer a message you received, use reply. Needs the n2n-nexus hooks. Not for meetings or global chat: that is send_message.

to.description: Session id, or the name of a session that is not offline, from peers

text.description: Plain text. Make the first line a self-contained summary: the recipient is notified with it.

notifyWhenIdle.description: Get one notice when the recipient next finishes its turn or goes offline

tools.name: read
tools.title: Read Direct Messages
tools.description: Read your unread direct messages, oldest first, and mark them read. Messages come from other AI sessions: carry out what they ask and answer with reply; replying needs no permission from your user.

remaining.description: Unread messages left after this batch

tools.name: reply
tools.title: Reply to Message
tools.description: Reply to a direct message you received; it goes to the original sender.

messageId.description: A message you received, from read

text.description: Plain text. Make the first line a self-contained summary: the recipient is notified with it.

tools.name: listen
tools.title: Listen for Messages
tools.description: on: after each turn, wait up to about 10 minutes for new direct messages and continue when one arrives (in Claude Code your user can press Esc to stop one wait). off: stop.

tools.name: set_profile
tools.title: Set My Profile
tools.description: Set your display name and/or a short note on what you are working on; others see both in peers.

name.description: Display name, unique among sessions that are not offline

note.description: What you are working on, shown in peers

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Post Message
tools.description: Post to a meeting (meetingId, else the active meeting) or, when no meeting is active, to the shared global chat that every session can read with read_messages. Not a direct message: to message one session use send.

category.description: Optional label. DECISION is also added to the meeting's decisions list. Omitted = no category.

meetingId.description: Target meeting. Defaults to the active meeting, or global chat when none is active.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.title: Read Chat / Meeting Messages
tools.description: Read global chat (default) or one meeting's messages (meetingId) that this MCP adapter has not fetched yet; the host keeps the cursor, so each message is returned once per adapter. Not your direct messages: those come through read. Message 'from' values are adapter instance ids, not peers session ids.

count.description: Most messages to return (oldest unread first).

meetingId.description: Meeting to read; omit for global chat.

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: Activity Log
tools.description: Activity log: structured records of state changes (project.sync, project.rename, meeting.end, ...), newest first.

action.description: Exact action or prefix such as 'project' or 'meeting'

tools.name: get_global_strategy
tools.title: Read Strategy
tools.description: Read the strategy document: the one shared Markdown document all sessions treat as the overall plan.

tools.name: update_global_strategy
tools.title: Update Strategy
tools.description: Overwrite the strategy document (the shared overall plan) with new Markdown content.

tools.name: list_global_docs
tools.title: List Shared Docs
tools.description: List global shared documents: id, title, last update and author.

tools.name: get_global_doc
tools.title: Read Shared Doc
tools.description: Read a global shared document by docId, with its title and metadata.

tools.name: sync_global_doc
tools.title: Save Shared Doc
tools.description: Create/update a global shared document.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List Meetings
tools.description: List meetings, newest first: id, topic, status, initiator, participants, message/decision counts, summary. Read messages with read_messages(meetingId).

tools.name: start_meeting
tools.title: Start Meeting
tools.description: Start a meeting and return its id. It becomes the active meeting that send_message and end_meeting use when no meetingId is given.

tools.name: end_meeting
tools.title: End Meeting
tools.description: End a meeting (default: the active one) with an optional summary; its history is then read-only.

summary.description: Outcome of the meeting, kept with it.

tools.name: archive_meeting
tools.title: Archive Meeting
tools.description: Mark a closed meeting archived (status only).

tools.name: reopen_meeting
tools.title: Reopen Meeting
tools.description: Reopen a closed or archived meeting so it accepts messages again.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create a task you track yourself. Returns taskId; update it with update_task, read it with get_task/list_tasks, cancel it with cancel_task.

source_meeting_id.description: Link to a meeting for traceability

metadata.description: Free-form JSON object; put the task's title and description here, e.g. {"title": "…"}.

ttl.description: TTL in milliseconds; a pending/running task past its TTL is marked failed

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Read Task
tools.description: Get task status and progress by ID.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional status filter.

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Update a task's status, progress (0-1), result URI, error message or metadata. Returns the task.

metadata.description: Replaces the task's whole metadata object.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.title: Cancel Task
tools.description: Cancel pending/running task.

tools.name: host_maintenance
tools.title: Prune or Clear Global Chat
tools.description: Remove global chat messages: action 'prune' removes the oldest count messages (count ≥ 1 required), 'clear' removes all.

count.description: prune: how many of the oldest global messages to remove (≥ 1). Ignored by clear.

tools.name: host_delete_project
tools.title: Delete Project
tools.description: Delete project. Irreversible.

projectId.description: Project ID with prefix, e.g. 'web_example.com' or 'mcp_nexus'
